queries.query: large language models network configuration generation "network configuration" "LLM" OR "large language model"
queries.rationale: Locate primary work applying LLMs to synthesize router/switch/firewall configs and configuration snippets; establishes phenomenon of automated config generation and current capabilities.
Find studies on translating operator intents or policies in NL to concrete network configs (intent-driven NetOps).

queries.query: generate-validate-repair pipeline LLM "network configuration" verify repair "self-correction"
queries.rationale: Survey architectures combining generation, automatic validation/verifiers, and repair loops for safe config synthesis.

queries.query: network configuration verification VeriFlow NetPlumber Anteater "network verification"
queries.rationale: Collect deterministic/semantic network-verification tools and algorithms to use as validators or baselines for operational correctness.

queries.query: LLM hallucination failure modes code synthesis "hallucination" "code generation" "configuration"
queries.rationale: Identify mechanisms and taxonomy of hallucinations and erroneous outputs relevant to config/code generation to inform failure-mode taxonomy.

queries.query: tool-assisted LLM verification "tool use" "verifier-guided" ReAct ReAct-style for system calls tools
queries.rationale: Find approaches where LLMs call external tools/verifiers (ReAct, Toolformer, tool-augmented agents) to improve correctness.

queries.query: AIOps benchmarks networking "AIOps" benchmark "network operations" dataset
queries.rationale: Locate benchmark suites, task families, and datasets proposed for AIOps/NetOps evaluation to assess benchmark validity and gaps.

queries.query: LLM evaluation methodology domain-specific tasks "operational correctness" metrics "ground truth"
queries.rationale: Search literature on evaluation protocols and metrics for operational or safety-critical domain tasks (precision/recall vs. semantic correctness).
Identify methods for stress-testing NetOps systems: fault injection, adversarial perturbations, and synthetic failures to probe robustness.

queries.query: formal methods config synthesis SMT model checking "network policy" synthesis
queries.rationale: Collect formal synthesis and verification methods (SMT, model checking) used to ensure policy compliance of generated configs.

queries.query: agentic frameworks for operations Auto-GPT LangChain LlamaIndex "orchestration" "tooling"
queries.rationale: Survey agentic/orchestration frameworks that enable multi-step tool-calling agents; relevant for designing NetOps agents and safety controls.
Gather operational case studies demonstrating real-world consequences of incorrect configs to motivate safety requirements.

queries.query: public datasets network configurations "router configs" "Cisco" dataset "network topology"
queries.rationale: Find publicly available network-config datasets, topology traces, or simulated corpora usable for training/evaluation and reproducibility.

queries.query: metrics for validator soundness completeness "validator" "soundness" "completeness" network verification
queries.rationale: Search for formal/empirical metrics to quantify validator correctness, false positives/negatives, and their impact on trust in generate-validate pipelines.

queries.query: human-in-the-loop NetOps evaluation operator trustworthiness "human-in-the-loop" "operator trust"
queries.rationale: Locate studies evaluating human oversight, operator acceptance, and trust metrics for assisted/autonomous NetOps tools.

queries.query: domain adaptation fine-tuning LLMs for networking "fine-tune" "domain adaptation" networking
queries.rationale: Collect studies on adapting/fine-tuning LLMs for specialized technical domains and their effect on correctness and hallucination rates.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed conference or journal papers and accepted preprints with verifiable metadata (title, authors, year, venue/identifier).
ArXiv/tech reports with accompanying code, data, or reproducible methods.
Public datasets, benchmark suites, and GitHub repositories with documented methods and license information.
Standards, RFCs, and IETF drafts relevant to network configuration semantics and intent APIs.
Operational postmortems and operator reports that include technical root-cause analysis.
exclusion_criteria: Unverifiable or anonymous web posts and social-media threads lacking citable metadata.
Marketing materials or vendor slide decks that do not include reproducible methods or data.
Non-technical opinion pieces without empirical or methodological content.
Non-English sources unless an authoritative translation and metadata are available.
Duplicate summaries referencing the same primary work without new evidence.
date_rationale: Prioritise literature from 2020–2026 to capture LLM-era methods, evaluation practices, and recent agentic frameworks; include foundational NetOps verification and formal-methods work from earlier (e.g., 2010s) when directly relevant to validators and semantics. Search window balances recency for LLMs with historical methods for verification and operational case studies.
